newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: HPL gets new partners for Milan hotel.
newsitem.headline: HPL gets new partners for Milan hotel.

text.p: Singapore based Hotel Properties Ltd (HPL) said on Thursday it has obtained new partners for its acquisition of the Four Seasons Hotel in Milan, Italy.
A company statement said HPL reduced its stake in FSHM Holdings Pte Ltd to 50 percent from 100 percent after admitting New Page Ltd as a joint venture partner.
New Page is in turn 80 percent owned by Hong Kong's Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd and 20 percent by Hong Kong Parkview Group Ltd.
HPL and New Page will each hold 50 percent of the joint venture company, FSHM, where the share capital will be increased to Singapore $33 million from the current S$2.
FSHM is the company used by HPL to acquire acquire Regent Milano SpA in October 1996. Regent Milano owns the Four Seasons Hotel in Milan and an adjoining apartment block.
